title: Transfer CT landmarks across real respiratory deformation
question: Real intra-patient respiratory shape change removes the global rigid/affine solution and may expose correspondence reasoning failures even when nominal acquisition geometry and standard registration libraries are available.
prior_findings: Stable difficulty is not established. The original BR-021 2D miss (12.641 mm RMS) was followed by two predeclared fresh Terra/high attempts: normal failure at 24.905 mm RMS and normal pass at 2.021 mm RMS. Exact replay and controlled interventions show that the original composition bug is secondary: repairing it leaves 12.410 mm RMS error. Search bounds exclude one target, and small-patch similarity favors some wrong matches. Larger context rescues both author patch models, while the passing agent uses broader candidate search and visual/stability checks with small numerical patches. A separately requested fresh Sol/xhigh attempt also passes: 1.563 mm RMS / 3.667 mm maximum. Its exact final-stage replay and four fixed component interventions identify q04 initialization as decisive under the final optimizer; final multiscale polishing is unnecessary after its earlier matching work.
next_action: Retire this exact 2D snapshot as a reliably difficult Terra candidate under the pass-retirement rule, preserving the original miss, fresh mixed outcomes and all counterfactuals as diagnostic evidence. The 3D snapshot remains retired. Any multi-patient replication or new difficulty condition requires a separately authorized, frozen study; none is scheduled.
